title: Mobility Equipment Retail Terms — Return of the Delivery Fee on a Kept Cash-Sale Chair
content:
# Delivery Fee Returned on a Kept Cash-Sale Chair — Mobility Equipment

**Term.** On a Mobility Equipment chair sold for cash that the patient keeps, the delivery fee is returned with the price adjustment according to how the repair was handled: when a loaner chair has been delivered for the chair, the delivery fee on the sale line is returned in full; when no loaner chair has been delivered and its own delivery (its purchase or initial rental delivery, not a loaner delivery) was made by courier, half the delivery fee is returned, rounded to the cent half up; otherwise no part of the delivery fee is returned.

## Records read

- **Loaner chair delivered** — a delivery in the chair's service history whose purpose is a loaner chair.
- **Own delivery by courier** — the chair's purchase delivery or initial rental delivery recorded with the mode courier.

## Decision table

| Loaner chair delivered for the chair | Own delivery by courier | Delivery fee returned |
|---|---|---|
| yes | either | in full |
| no | yes | half, rounded to the cent half up |
| no | no (in the home with training, or branch pickup) | none |

## Worked examples (hypothetical delivery fees)

- Fee 149.00, loaner delivered: 149.00 returned.
- Fee 149.00, no loaner, courier delivery: half is 74.50.
- Fee 24.99, no loaner, courier delivery: half is 12.495, rounded half up to 12.50.
- Fee 25.00, no loaner, chair picked up at a branch: nothing returned.
